description: This file defines the CommitMessageProvider class which orchestrates commit message generation by routing requests to VSCode and JetBrains adapters, handles command registration, and manages workspace context.

classes.name: CommitMessageProvider
classes.description: A class that manages commit message generation requests, registers commands, and coordinates between VSCode and JetBrains adapters.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Registers commands to generate commit messages for VSCode and JetBrains.

methods.name: handleVSCodeCommand
methods.description: Handles the VSCode command to generate a commit message, converting the request and invoking the adapter.

methods.name: handleJetBrainsCommand
methods.description: Handles the JetBrains command to generate a commit message, extracting arguments and invoking the adapter.

methods.name: determineWorkspacePath
methods.description: Determines the workspace path from a URI or current workspace context.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources and disposes of adapters.
